caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical cast iron gate and fence in black and white with fine line shading, framed by a double-line rectangular border. The gate consists of two hinged panels meeting at the center and each panel is bordered by vertical posts on either side with ornate finials at the top. The lower section of each gate panel contains a rectangular wooden or wood-textured surface, bordered by detailed ironwork, and features a large decorative rosette in the center. Above these panels, the mid-section contains vertical iron bars spaced evenly, connected by horizontal rails with additional decorative elements. The upper section is adorned with a repeating pattern of ornate spearhead finials and curved motifs forming a crest. The gate appears to stand on a paved surface indicated by rectangular stone tiles, and below the drawing, centered text reads “CAST IRON GATE AND FENCE.”
title: Cast Iron Gate
